blocks.x: Marketing Intelligence & CX Orchestration: the composed architecture, the platforms underneath and the metric the program is judged on.
The problem this solution exists for
Attribution wars persist because measurement infrastructure doesn't exist; creative production bottlenecks on manual cycles; CX signals from service and product never join the marketing loop.
Our approach

We deploy clean-room measurement with test-and-holdout discipline, build the creative factory under brand guardrails, and orchestrate CX signals (contact drivers, churn intents) into campaign and product actions.
Components

items: Variant generation with brand guardrails and QC
Service and product signals into targeting
Holdout discipline on every major spend

blocks.x: Platform stack
The solution runs on Dataq Nexus and Dataq Compass: Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — with a full evidence trail for each decision. Model governance your risk committee and regulator can review.
How it runs in an engagement

items: Baseline metrics for this problem locked with owners; current-state decision/data flow mapped in two weeks.
Gated pilot on bounded scope with the testable criterion agreed by finance before the first build sprint.
Staged rollout on the platform stack with SLOs, replay evidence and operator enablement.
Challenger models and policies quarterly; conformance monitoring; annual value audit against baseline.

blocks.x: What you get

items: Reference architecture adapted to your estate, with the integration contracts itemized.
The composed capability live on bounded scope, with audit evidence produced automatically.
Runbooks, SLO catalog and the named-pod accountability chain for production.
Baseline pack, measurement method and the quarterly review template your finance team signs.

blocks.x: Prerequisites and data readiness

The readiness checklist covers three items: source-system access under your security policy, an operating team willing to trial the new workflow, and agreement on the baseline measurement method before work starts.
Proof

items: Real-time fraud decisioning on instant rails: 38% lower fraud losses at a higher approval rate
KYC refresh backlog cleared: 70% faster cycles with agentic file assembly

blocks.x: Industry fit

Deployed across Retail & Consumer Goods, Telecom, Media & Entertainment, Technology & SaaS. Each industry play adjusts the regulatory frame, the integration surface and the KPI set — the pattern stays, the physics changes.
Outcomes we commit to
How a delivery runs

The weekly rhythm below is identical across programs of this type. Weeks 1–2 belong to measurement: the baseline metric is captured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 run a bounded pilot — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — steered by a control owner on your side. Weeks 9–12 convert the pilot into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, and close with a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses a gate is stopped or redirected on the record.
